title: Home guide: the waterproof test
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Everyday materials (Moon Zoom! and Rain & Sunrays)
source: Written for science/y1 lesson 7 (Home practical guide and safety card: the waterproof test (portal worksheet): do it on a tray, wipe spills at once)
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Find out which fabric keeps water out.
equipment: Fabrics: kitchen roll, an old sock, a plastic bag (an adult holds it)
safety: Do it on a tray and wipe spills at once
Keep plastic bags away from faces
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Put a cup on the tray.
Stretch one fabric over the top. An adult puts the elastic band round it.
Pour one teaspoon of water on the fabric.
Count to 10. Lift the fabric. Is the cup dry?
Do the same with the other fabrics.

head: Fabric
Is the cup dry? (tick or cross)
